subject: CAIQ response and runtime control lineage plan — Halcyon Health
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@halcyonhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Halcyon Health Security <security@halcyonhealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-01 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ intake — runtime controls / artifact ask

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Halcyon’s architecture review team requested a CAIQ-style mapping focused on runtime controls and evidence we can pull for a live assessment. They want answers that tie CAIQ control IDs to concrete runtime artifacts (e.g., KV cache isolation proof, tenant routing policy, KMS key rotation logs, and sample telemetry traces).

Can you share:
- A completed CAIQ spreadsheet with the control-level responses we plan to assert
- A manifest of the artifacts we can provide (log snippets, config exports, privilege lists)
- A short note on what we cannot provide from hosted environments and the recommended Private/Dedicated options if required

Goal: Halcyon needs a submission-ready package by July 8 so their internal audit can slot us into their vendor review.

Appreciate a quick call if useful — Alex

[signature]
Alex Turner
Head of IT Security, Halcyon Health
[Attachment: halcyon_questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-01 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ intake — runtime controls / artifact ask

Folks — forwarding Halcyon’s ask. They specifically want control-level lineage for runtime behaviors (cache, routing, KMS, tenant segregation) and concrete artifacts.

Quick notes / asks:
- Jordan: can you own the CAIQ sheet update? Focus responses for controls in the KA (Key Access), IS (Isolation), and OT (Operational Telemetry) categories.
- Kim: can you assemble the evidence manifest and confirm which artifacts are safe to share from Hosted vs. Dedicated/Private? Include any redaction steps needed for tenant identifiers.
- Timeline: draft to Alex by EOD July 4, final package by July 8.

I think we should include: short mapping doc (1 page) that explains how the runtime traces map to CAIQ control language. Halcyon will escalate if we leave ambiguous statements.

Thanks — Marissa
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

On Jul 1, 2028, at 09:14, Alex Turner <alex.turner@halcyonhealth.com> wrote:
> Hi Marissa,
>
> Thanks again for the demo last week — Halcyon’s architecture review team requested a CAIQ-style mapping focused on runtime controls and evidence we can pull for a live assessment....

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-03 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: CAIQ intake — runtime controls / artifact ask

Thanks — jumping in. Progress update:

1) CAIQ draft: I pulled the latest CAIQ template and added a runtime column where I map our assertion to the exact artifact type (config, log, telemetry, replay snippet). I focused on these controls in particular: CSA-RT-01 (runtime isolation), CSA-RT-07 (KV cache segregation), CSA-CR-03 (crypto key lifecycle), CSA-OP-12 (telemetry retention and sampling).

2) Evidence slices I can produce from Hosted:
- Redacted KV cache access logs (sample window: 2028-06-21T10:00Z — 2028-06-21T10:30Z)
- Request routing policy exports (JSON) for the tenant routing tier
- KMS rotation audit entries (HSM-backed key IDs, rotation timestamps — redacted key material)

3) Evidence that requires Dedicated/Private or legal gating:
- Live tenant-level raw request traces with full PII (we can provide redacted snippets instead)
- Full audit log streams for multi-tenant ingestion windows older than 90 days (retention policy)

4) Attachments I’ll produce: CAIQ response spreadsheet (redwood_caiq_response_v0.3.xlsx) and a short mapping doc in the sheet. Kim — can you assemble the evidence_manifest_halcyon_v1.pdf and confirm S3 share link or DocuSign gating for any NDAed items?

Plan: draft back to Alex on Jul 4 EOD for review. If Halcyon wants tenant-level replay we should propose a Dedicated trial or an on-prem snapshot.

—Jordan
Sr. Security PM, Redwood Inference

On Jul 1, 2028, at 10:03, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Folks — forwarding Halcyon’s ask....

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@halcyonhealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-05 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ response and runtime control lineage plan — Halcyon Health

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the patience — attached is our draft CAIQ response spreadsheet and a scannable evidence manifest. Highlights:

- What we assert: For controls related to runtime isolation and KV cache segregation we provide redacted log slices and policy exports that demonstrate tenant separation across the serving runtime. Example artifacts: redacted_kv_access_20280621.log (sampling), tenant_routing_policy_2028-06-01.json.
- KMS: rotation entries + key lifecycle diagram (audit entries only; key material is never shared).
- Telemetry: we included short replay snippets (runtime_trace_snippets.zip) showing request path, latency buckets, and sampling decisions; these are suitable for auditors and scrubbed of patient data.
- Items gated by contract: full raw traces and complete audit streams older than 90 days — we propose a short Dedicated trial or a Private deployment for those needs and outline the steps in the manifest.

Attachments included: redwood_caiq_response_v0.3.xlsx, evidence_manifest_halcyon_v1.pdf, runtime_trace_snippets.zip.

Next steps (requested):
1) Alex — confirm a single point of contact for the evidence portal and any NDA requirements.
2) If Halcyon needs a tenant-level replay, let us know and we’ll propose Dedicated trial dates and estimated uplift.
3) Marissa/Jordan — please confirm the final wording in the CAIQ answers (I flagged three items where we softened language to avoid over-assertion).

Best,
Kimberly Park
Security Operations Lead, Redwood Inference

[Attachments: redwood_caiq_response_v0.3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), evidence_manifest_halcyon_v1.pdf (application/pdf), runtime_trace_snippets.zip (application/zip)]
body_preview: Halcyon requests CAIQ mappings tied to runtime artifacts. Internal owners assigned: Jordan to update sheet, Kim to assemble artifacts. Attachments include CAIQ spreadsheet and evidence manifest. Proposal: redacted logs provided from Hosted, tenant-level replay requires Dedicated/Private.
